# Bundled font and stylesheet notices

License text files have trailing whitespace normalized. Font binaries are retained unchanged. The downloaded CSS files only have their resource URLs changed to local paths.

| Files under `dist/fonts/` | License / notice |
| --- | --- |
| `pretendard/` | [Pretendard OFL](Pretendard-OFL.txt) |
| `cinev/6f826e9f9b03ddb0-s.p.otf` (Poppins) | [Poppins OFL](Poppins-OFL.txt) |
| `cinev/923dc277b1eb7754-s.p.ttf` (Roboto Slab) | [Apache 2.0](RobotoSlab-Apache-2.0.txt), [copyright](RobotoSlab-NOTICE.txt) |
| `cinev/MaruBuri-Regular.woff` | [NAVER OFL notice](MaruBuri-OFL.txt); embedded copyright: © NAVER Corp. © NAVER Cultural Foundation Corp. |
| `katex/katex-swap.min.css` | [KaTeX MIT](KaTeX-MIT.txt) |
| `katex/files/` | [Embedded font notices and OFL](KaTeX-fonts-OFL.txt), [font build project MIT](KaTeX-font-build-MIT.txt) |

## Sources

- Pretendard-OFL.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/orioncactus/pretendard/v1.3.9/LICENSE
- Poppins-OFL.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/poppins/OFL.txt
- RobotoSlab-Apache-2.0.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/apache/robotoslab/LICENSE.txt
- KaTeX-MIT.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/v0.16.25/LICENSE
- KaTeX-font-build-MIT.txt: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KaTeX/katex-fonts/master/LICENSE
- MaruBuri-OFL.txt: https://help.naver.com/service/11029/contents/18088?lang=ko&osType=PC (license section extracted as text; whitespace normalized).
- KaTeX-fonts-OFL.txt: copyright, reserved font names, and license declarations extracted from each bundled TTF; SIL OFL 1.1 text from Poppins-OFL.txt.
- RobotoSlab-NOTICE.txt: bundled TTF name table.
